sloka: इमानि बहु दुर्गाणि नद्यः शैल अंतराणि च ।भवन्तः परिमार्गन्तु बुद्धि विक्रम संपदा ॥४-४३-१०॥
transliteration: imāni bahu durgāṇi nadyaḥ śaila aṁtarāṇi ca ।bhavantaḥ parimārgantu buddhi vikrama saṁpadā ॥4-43-10॥

translations.english: 'You are rich in wisdom and valour. You should search for Sita everywhere including inaccessible forests and mountain ranges.
